name: se2
description: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature, Implement, and live session Audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature, Implement, and Audit workflows.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit durable-context, Idea capture, Feature planning, GitHub-Feature-to-PR implementation, and live session Audit entry points. Learn maintains evidence-backed repository context, ADRs, localization memory, and proposal-first AGENTS.md compaction. Idea captures transient session context and publishes only through an explicitly authorized G-owned terminal operation. Feature converges authoritative Feature issues, vertical Task issues, and acyclic Task dependency graphs. Implement coordinates a Sol/medium control plane with adaptive Sol workers, exact-HEAD in-session review, Feature Contract Repair, verified PR outputs, and a minimal SQLite WAL recovery ledger. Audit observes active SE2 sessions read-only, reconstructs workflow-graph conformance from positive evidence, and reports feedback, bugs, regressions, graph violations, and graph-design improvements without persistent state. Root contracts standardize graph vocabulary, live task preflight, destination and identity observation, update relay, and reconciliation.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:learn for durable repository knowledge or $se2:idea for transient capture and explicit GitHub publication.
Use $se2:feature to plan or repair authoritative GitHub Features and Task DAGs through its graph-first workflow.
Use $se2:implement for verified Feature-to-PR delivery, or $se2:audit to monitor active SE2 graph runs read-only.
